digest.component_or_area: fsck command and store layer architecture
propositions: Three filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are defined in fsck_repair.py but logically belong in a store module and have no semantic relation to repair operations
Seven production modules import these three primitives from fsck_repair or fsck, creating an inverted dependency where store-layer code (gitutil) depends on command-layer repair code

Moving the three primitives to gitutil.py preserves the stdlib-only leaf property of gitutil (no module-level rebar imports except function-local ones) and aligns with the existing consumer direction (commands importing store)

Compatibility surfaces must be preserved: fsck.py continues re-exporting the symbols, and fsck_repair.py retains module-level bindings for the three names so that existing test patches via monkeypatch.setattr still resolve
